en_US: Were you looking for me?
Did you miss me?
I wish I had a new nugget of wisdom
to share with you, but alas, I don’t!
So, I’ll have to make it up to you
with this!
Oh, why not? Take another!
It makes up for the wisdom I lack!
Those are my Nuggets!
Try to spend them wisely!
Nuggets of gold have to be worth
more than nuggets of my wisdom!
Resort Area
Oh, are you partaking in our little
island challenge in the Battle Zone?
I’m probably one of your stops, then.
My name is Gene.
I like to stand by the water here to
help myself cool down from the heat.
You see, I use Normal-type Pokémon...
And that doesn’t help to cool down!
So, are you interested in a battle
for your {COLOR 1}General Badge{COLOR 0}?
Show me what makes your Pokémon
extra special!
Congratulations.
This badge is well deserved...
{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} received
the General Badge from Gene!
The General Badge is a token of
victory over plain but dangerous foes.
Gene: Normal-type Pokémon may seem
boring to the untrained eye...
But their ability to wield multiple types
in battle is almost unparalleled!
